name: [Admin cabang][Happy path] Receiving a full purchase order completes it and adds stock
description: A PO for 10 units received in full moves to completed and increases on-hand stock by 10.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /login and sign in with the environment's test account
Open the stock list (Stok Barang), search for 'PRIMA GA3', and note its stock
Open the purchase order page (Pesan Barang) and start a new purchase order
Choose the supplier 'UJI Pemasok TestSprite', add the product PRIMA GA3 with quantity 10 and unit price 3000, and save the purchase order
Open the goods receipt page (Terima Barang) and start a new receipt
Pull the data from the purchase order just created, keep the received quantity at 10, and choose credit (tempo/hutang) payment if asked
Save the goods receipt
Open the purchase order list
Verify the purchase order for UJI Pemasok TestSprite has status completed (selesai)
Open the stock list and search for 'PRIMA GA3'
Verify the PRIMA GA3 stock is exactly 10 higher than the number noted at the start

name: [Admin cabang][Validasi][PROC-01] Receiving more than ordered is refused
description: A PO line of 10 units must not accept a receipt of 15 units.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /login and sign in with the environment's test account
Open the purchase order page (Belanja Barang > 1. Pesan Barang (PO)) and start a new purchase order for supplier 'UJI Pemasok TestSprite'
In the product field of the first line, type the exact SKU 'BR1-LXELU2' and press Enter; the field must then read 'BR1-LXELU2 — KOVIN PLUS 5GR*20*50'. Do not type into that field again
Set quantity 10 and unit price 3250, then save the purchase order and note its number
Open the goods receipt page (2. Terima Barang), start a new receipt, and pull the data from the noted purchase order
Change the received quantity of KOVIN PLUS 5GR*20*50 to 15, choose credit (tempo/hutang) if asked
Save the goods receipt
Verify the save is rejected with a message that the quantity exceeds what remains on the order, and the noted purchase order is not marked completed (selesai)

name: [Admin cabang][Logika][PROC-01] PO stays partial while any line is still open
description: Receiving 10 of item A and 0 of item B on a 10+10 order must not mark the PO completed.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /login and sign in with the environment's test account
Open the purchase order page (Belanja Barang > 1. Pesan Barang (PO)) and start a new purchase order for supplier 'UJI Pemasok TestSprite'

In the product field of the first line, type the exact SKU 'BR1-12NAWA' and press Enter; the field must then read 'BR1-12NAWA — GIBGRO 10SP 5GR*25*40'. Set quantity 10 and unit price 3550. Do not type into that product field again
Add a second line, type the exact SKU 'ARF-9627EB33' in its product field and press Enter; it must read 'ARF-9627EB33 — BAUT L SOLO'. Set quantity 10 and unit price 2000
Save the purchase order and note its number
Open the goods receipt page (2. Terima Barang), start a new receipt, and pull the data from the noted purchase order
Set the GIBGRO 10SP received quantity to 10 and the BAUT L SOLO received quantity to 0 (or remove that line if 0 is not accepted), choose credit (tempo/hutang) if asked, and save
Verify the noted purchase order status is partial (sebagian), not completed (selesai), and its detail still shows 10 units of BAUT L SOLO outstanding

name: [Admin cabang][Validasi][PROC-03] Purchase return above the received quantity is refused
description: Returning 8 units against a receipt of 5 must be blocked and stock must not go negative.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /login and sign in with the environment's test account
Open the purchase order page (Belanja Barang > 1. Pesan Barang (PO)) and start a new purchase order for supplier 'UJI Pemasok TestSprite'
In the product field of the first line, type the exact SKU 'BR1-MNQBZD' and press Enter; the field must then read 'BR1-MNQBZD — PRIMA BLACK 15GR*10*100'. Do not type into that field again
Set quantity 5 and unit price 2400, then save the purchase order
Open the goods receipt page (2. Terima Barang), start a new receipt, pull the data from that purchase order, keep 5 units, choose credit (tempo/hutang) if asked, and save
Open https://majubersama.online/backoffice/purchase-returns/create directly in the address bar (the branch admin menu has no link to it)
Choose supplier 'UJI Pemasok TestSprite' and, if a goods-receipt selector exists, link the receipt just created
In the product field type the exact SKU 'BR1-MNQBZD' and press Enter, then set the return quantity to 8
Save the purchase return

Verify the save is rejected with a message about the quantity exceeding the received or available amount, and https://majubersama.online/backoffice/purchase-returns shows no new return for UJI Pemasok TestSprite

name: [Admin cabang][Integritas data][AR-01] Receivable payment cannot exceed the invoice balance
description: Paying far more than an invoice's balance must be rejected, or the cash amount must equal the allocation.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /login and sign in with the environment's test account
Open the cashier screen (Kasir POS) and open a shift with opening cash 100000 if asked
Select customer 'UJI Pelanggan Tempo', add 6 units of KOVIN PLUS, and finish with the tempo payment method, a due date 30 days ahead, and a down payment of 0; note the receipt number
Open the receivable payment form (Terima Bayaran Piutang)
Search for 'UJI Pelanggan Tempo' and select the noted invoice so its allocation fills with the outstanding balance
Change the header payment amount to the outstanding balance plus 150000
Save the payment
Verify the save is rejected with a message that the payment amount must equal the allocated amount or cannot exceed the outstanding balance

name: [Admin cabang][Logika][RET-01] A fully returned tempo invoice no longer shows a receivable to collect
description: After all items of an unpaid tempo invoice are returned, the receivable payment form must not offer the original balance.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /login and sign in with the environment's test account
Open the cashier screen (Kasir POS) and open a shift with opening cash 100000 if asked
Select customer 'UJI Pelanggan Tempo', add 1 unit of GIBGRO 10SP (SKU BR1-12NAWA), and finish with the tempo payment method, a due date 30 days ahead, and a down payment of 0; note the receipt number
Open the sales return entry form (Jualan > Retur dari Pelanggan > + Input Retur Pelanggan) and select the noted receipt in the receipt selector

In the product field type the exact SKU 'BR1-12NAWA' and press Enter; the field must then read 'BR1-12NAWA — GIBGRO 10SP 5GR*25*40'. Set the return quantity to 1 and do not type into the product field again
Save the sales return
Open the receivable payment form (Jualan > Terima Bayaran Piutang) and search for 'UJI Pelanggan Tempo'
Verify the noted receipt is either absent from the open invoices or shows an outstanding balance of Rp 0

name: [Admin cabang][Logika][RET-02] Return refund equals the discounted price on the receipt
description: Returning items from a discounted sale must refund the net amount actually paid, not the catalog price.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /login and sign in with the environment's test account
Open the cashier screen (Kasir POS) and open a shift with opening cash 100000 if asked
Add 2 units of PRIMA GA3 (SKU ARF-4639C5A4), give that cart line a discount of 1000, and finish with cash at the exact amount; note the receipt number and grand total (Rp 7.000)
Open the sales return entry form (Jualan > Retur dari Pelanggan > + Input Retur Pelanggan) and select the noted receipt in the receipt selector

In the product field type the exact SKU 'ARF-4639C5A4' and press Enter; the field must then read 'ARF-4639C5A4 — PRIMA GA3'. Set the return quantity to 2, leave the suggested refund price unchanged, and do not type into the product field again
Note the refund total shown on the form before saving
Save the sales return
Verify the saved return in the return list shows a refund total of Rp 7.000 for the noted receipt, and the form did not suggest Rp 8.000 before saving

name: [Admin cabang][Validasi] Customer form rejects an empty name
description: Saving a customer with no name must show a field error and create nothing.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /login and sign in with the environment's test account
Open the customer page (Data Pelanggan) and start adding a new customer
Leave the name empty, enter phone 080000000019, and save
Verify a validation message appears next to the name field and the customer list does not contain a new row with phone 080000000019
